pipeline.modality: Virus-like drug conjugate (VDC) — HPV VLP + phthalocyanine photosensitizer; light-activated cytotoxic plus immune activation
pipeline.target: Modified tumor-associated heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs/GAGs) on solid tumor cells
pipeline.license_origin: In-house (collaboration with NIH on VLP platform)

indications.indication: Early choroidal melanoma (small choroidal melanoma / indeterminate lesions, first-line)
indications.trial_design: Global, randomized, masked, sham-controlled superiority trial; ~100 patients 2:1:2 high-dose bel-sar / low-dose / sham SC injection + laser; primary endpoint time to tumor progression at 15 months; SPA agreement with FDA
indications.trial_status: Recruiting; enrollment expected complete mid-2026; topline H2 2027

indications.trial_design: Phase 2, ~12-24 patients with unilateral/unifocal choroidal metastasis from any primary solid tumor; SC administration + laser; safety, tumor shrinkage, visual acuity, dose/regimen finding
key_milestones: FDA Fast Track Designation (Division of Oncology) for metastases to the choroid

indications.indication: Cancers of the ocular surface (conjunctival melanoma, squamous cell carcinoma)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 proof-of-concept trial in Australia; safety, feasibility, tumor response by histopathology at 2-4 weeks
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — initiating in Australia; early PoC data expected 2026

indications.indication: Non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC, intermediate and high-risk)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1b/2 evaluating two front-line interventions: neoadjuvant prior to TURBT and immune-ablative (without TURBT); additional doses/cycles; durability up to 12 months
key_milestones: FDA Fast Track Designation in NMIBC

excluded_preclinical: Future expansion into additional solid tumor indications based on VDC platform (preclinical)
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT04417530 Phase 2 SC bel-sar early choroidal melanoma (COMPLETED, supportive)
NCT03052127 Phase 1/2 small primary choroidal melanoma (COMPLETED, supportive)
